metadata.title: G1-Warrant Deterministic Autonomous Remediation, Containment & Attestation Control Plane

components.title: g1-warrant-core
components.description: Zero-LLM deterministic remediation control plane enforcing 2-of-2 DSSE Standing Warrants, OPA Rego AC-5 separation of duties, shadow canary differential gates, eBPF containment lockouts, and NIST OSCAL 1.1.2 POA&M closure attestations.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 4 baseline compliance implementation for G1-Warrant

implemented-requirements.description: Every autonomous rollout, Cilium containment bridge, and exception resolution is gated by cryptographic Standing Warrant verification (fail-closed on missing, expired, or out-of-scope warrants). External auditor bearer tokens (g1aud_*) are strictly isolated to /api/v1/auditor/* and return HTTP 403 on all operational endpoints.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/warrant/engine.go + internal/server/api.go Scoped Auditor Bearer Isolation

implemented-requirements.description: Untrusted external prose (SARIF 2.1.0, CISA KEV feeds, Google OSV.dev advisories, CycloneDX VEX) is routed exclusively through the zero-privilege warrant-extractor service deployed on an isolated zero-egress network segment, emitting only regex-validated typed records.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: cmd/warrant-extractor + k8s/network-policy.yaml (Zero-Egress Content vs. Artifact Separation)

implemented-requirements.description: Standing Warrants and Ceiling Exceptions require 2-of-2 cryptographic signatures over RFC 8785 JCS canonicalized DSSEv1 PAE bytes from two distinct human principals holding disjoint institutional roles: Slot 1 SERVICE_OWNER and Slot 2 AUTHORIZING_OFFICIAL. Self-co-signing and role collisions are deterministically rejected.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: policies/warrant_ac5.rego + internal/crypto/dsse.go (2-of-2 Dual-Key Separation of Duties)

implemented-requirements.description: All Standing Warrant issuances, short-lived Task Warrant delegations (TTL <= 300s), extractor sanitizations, progressive canary transitions, containment bridges, and POA&M closures generate structured, timestamped cryptographic audit records with SHA-256 input/output lineage.

PostgreSQL BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers enforce strict append-only immutability on standing_warrants, agent_action_ledger, and oscal_attestations, raising IMMUTABLE_LEDGER_VIOLATION on any mutation attempt while chaining prev_hash -> entry_hash across all rows.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: db/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql PostgreSQL WORM Triggers + SHA-256 Hash Chains

implemented-requirements.description: Warrants, ceiling exceptions, and NIST OSCAL 1.1.2 closure attestations are sealed inside DSSEv1 envelopes signed via Ed25519 or W3C WebAuthn hardware authenticators over RFC 8785 JCS payloads, enabling offline and in-browser non-repudiation verification.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/crypto/{jcs,dsse,webauthn}.go + Client-Side Browser DSSE Verifier

implemented-requirements.description: Background control-plane reconciliation continuously polls running workload image digests and Cilium NetworkPolicy attachment states against attested closures, raising DRIFT_REOPENED alerts upon tampering and optionally syncing live CISA KEV and OSV.dev threat catalogs.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/server/orchestrator.go Continuous Drift Sweeper + Live CISA KEV / OSV Poller

implemented-requirements.description: Workloads must satisfy baseline readiness gates (>= 80% automated test coverage, OpenTelemetry probes, read-only shadow replica binding, and verified < 60s rollback automation) before qualifying for autonomous progressive rollout.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: policies/gate_eligibility.rego + N2 Estate Autonomous Eligibility Scorecard

implemented-requirements.description: Enforces stateless patch checks (zero DDL or ORM mutations) and compares baseline vs. canary JCS-normalized schemas, p50/p95/p99 latency ceilings, and Linux syscall capability sets, triggering instant rollback to baseline digest on any regression.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/gate/engine.go Progressive Canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) & Instant Rollback

implemented-requirements.description: Authenticates organizational authorizing officials and service owners via native W3C WebAuthn hardware authenticators (RPID hash check, User Present & User Verified flags, ECDSA P-256 / Ed25519 verification) and live principal revocation checks.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/crypto/webauthn.go Native W3C WebAuthn PIV/FIDO2 Verification

implemented-requirements.description: External scanner and remediation workers operate solely as governed delegates under Ed25519-signed ephemeral Task Warrants (max TTL 300s) bound to an active human-co-signed Standing Warrant and explicit target asset scope.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/agentcp/controlplane.go Minute-Scoped Ephemeral Task Warrants

implemented-requirements.description: Ingests SARIF 2.1.0, CycloneDX/VEX, CISA KEV, and Google OSV.dev advisories for race-triage prioritization, and requires deterministic HTTP exploit-replay rejection plus full pod digest verification before closing any vulnerability.

Deploys immediate virtual containment shields within SLA windows for unpatched or above-ceiling vulnerabilities and enforces permanent post-patch runtime network/process lockout policies verified by active canary probes.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/adapters/cilium_shield.go OpenC2 / Cilium eBPF Containment & Runtime Lockout

implemented-requirements.description: Verifies container image SHA-256 digests across every replica in the target fleet and validates unbroken genesis-to-head cryptographic hash chains across all three PostgreSQL WORM ledgers.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: policies/verify_closure.rego + internal/ledger/engine.go SHA-256 Digest & Chain Verification
